brief_title: Study to Assess the Effect of Food on Combination Dapagliflozin/Metformin Tablet in Healthy Volunteers
official_title: An Open Label, Randomized, Two-period, Crossover Study to Assess the Effect of Food on Fixed Dose Combination Dapagliflozin/Metformin Tablet (5 mg/1000 mg) in Healthy Male and Female Volunteers

primary_outcomes.measure: To assess the effect of food on the pharmacokinetics of dapagliflozin and metformin.
primary_outcomes.time_frame: Serial PK sampling will be done on Days 1-4 at visit 2 and 3.

brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether treatment with a fixed dose combination dapagliflozin/metformin tablet is affected by food.

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Healthy
* BMI 18-30 kg/m2

Exclusion Criteria:

* History of clinically significant illness.
* History of alcohol or drug abuse
